A '''Killik nest''' was inhabited by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. During the [[War against Celestial client species|war]] between the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] and the client species of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]], the nest was [[Storming of a Killik nest|stormed]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] warriors.<ref name="EGtW" />
